query:
SELECT
            e.name as exercise_name,
            cs.set_number as "set_number: i32",
            cs.weight as "weight: f32",
            cs.reps as "reps: i32",
            cs.notes
        FROM completed_sets cs
        JOIN exercises e ON cs.exercise_id = e.id
        WHERE cs.active_workout_id = ?
        ORDER BY cs.completed_at
